{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for SEVERE disease
print(f"Unique severity levels: {df['severity'].unique()}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id rows: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check assay_batch values
print(f"Assay batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check if there are multiple sample_seq per patient
sample_seq_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique()
double_tested = sample_seq_counts[sample_seq_counts > 1]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(double_tested)}")"}
